news.summary: Ravi Teja's Telugu blockbuster Irumudi has surged to the number one position globally on Netflix's Non-English Movies category. news.title: Tollywood Faces Major Financial Realities as OTT Platforms Slash Budgets
news.summary: Digital streaming platforms have drastically reduced their acquisition budgets, refusing to pay inflated prices for Telugu movies. This shift has created a massive gap between producers' financial expectations and actual offers, placing high-budget films and medium-range projects at significant risk. Consequently, filmmakers may soon need to depend entirely on theatrical box-office earnings for revenue recovery.
